question: For Noah Weber's partially comprehensive motor policy, is vehicle theft generally covered and what deductible is recorded?

payload.answer:
Vehicle theft is generally covered under the applicable terms: the insurance covers loss, disappearance, destruction or damage caused by theft, misappropriation or robbery of the insured vehicle, subject to the individual policy conditions and exclusions [motor-vehicle-insurance-sti.pdf, page 13].
Vehicle theft is generally covered under the applicable terms: the insurance covers loss, disappearance, destruction or damage caused by theft, misappropriation or robbery, subject to the policy conditions and exclusions [motor-vehicle-insurance-sti.pdf, page 13].
The theft-related damage must have occurred involuntarily [motor-vehicle-insurance-sti.pdf, page 13].
No compensation is paid if the act was committed by family members [motor-vehicle-insurance-sti.pdf, page 13].
